image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a heavily rusted, thick metal chain link. The link is oval-shaped with a rough, textured surface showing significant oxidation (rust) in shades of orange and brown. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green, suggesting an outdoor setting. The lighting highlights the texture of the rust.
